title: Replace does not update workflow rules; the rule keeps the old value that moved to Unused (TAVI vs Zoho CRM)
label: BUG
env: TAVI NDC-Staging · set QA GS1111 Tier, rule QA GS1111 Bronze rule (off except during the run) · Zoho CRM test org org944965048 · set QA GS1111 Tier, field update QA GS1111 set Silver

panels.caption: TAVI · API checks: replace succeeds but the rule criteria and action keep the old value
Zoho · Replace Values: "replaced in all the used places (Records, Criteria, Workflow Actions, Field Dependency)"

rows: Rule criteria uses the replaced value
Criteria follow the new value (Replace note: Criteria)
Criteria stay "Bronze" (now Unused); the rule silently stops matching
Rule field update uses the replaced value
Seen live: field update "set Silver Plus" changed to Gold after Replace
Rule wrote "Silver" onto a new lead although Silver is no longer offered
